ValidationRule.description: Non-blocker tasks must sit in sprint ceil(ISO week / 2), sprint must be whole and <= 27, and the ISO year cannot be older than last year.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Sprint_Number__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Due_Date__c)), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Severity__c, 'Blocker')), OR( Sprint_Number__c <> CEILING(ISOWEEK(Due_Date__c) / 2), MOD(Sprint_Number__c, 1) <> 0, Sprint_Number__c > 27, ISOYEAR(Due_Date__c) < YEAR(TODAY()) - 1 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sprint Number does not match the due date's ISO calendar.
